limpidR 0.1.0 bundled demonstration data

The data files in this directory are fully synthetic and deterministic. They follow the LIMPID-India table schema so package examples, tests and vignettes can run without redistributing the full research database or any third-party observational data.

Coverage:
- 6 fictional freshwater systems
- 24 fictional lake-event summaries
- abundance, morphology, size and polymer composition tables
- synthetic method, QA/QC, environmental, spatial and provenance metadata

These values are for software demonstration and testing only. They must not be interpreted as scientific observations or used for environmental inference.

The full LIMPID-India research database is distributed separately as a versioned research-data product.
